articles.summary: Dallas, Texas, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Outdoor Holding Company (Nasdaq: POWW, POWWP) (“OHC,” “we,” “us,” “our” or the “Company”), the owner of GunBroker.com , the largest online marketplace dedicated to firearms, hunting, shooting and related products, today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) approved an amendment to the Company’s share repurchase program that increases the aggregate repurchase authorization from $15 million to $35 million and extends the program by six months, through July 4, 2027. The $35 million authorization includes all repurchases made since the program was launched in January 2026 and represents a $20 million increase over the prior authorization. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had repurchased approximately $8.4 million of its common stock under the program, excluding commissions and fees, leaving approximately $6.6 million available under the prior authorization. articles.title: Outdoor Holding Company Increases Aggregate Share Repurchase Authorization to $35 Million and Extends Program Through July 4, 2027
